integrity: The exact return formula and finite branch itinerary were checked analytically; the attached standalone program supplies supplemental symbolic and high-precision examples. The result has not received independent mathematical review.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the one-nonlinear-visit period-M word at a critical slope, not all dynamics; it holds for all sufficiently large M with an unspecified M0. The subcritical doubled-period orbit is local in parameter. Complete publication-priority certainty is unavailable.
title: Exponentially thin attracting-cycle windows at the critical grazing slope
